column1: # Landmarks for the tenki.jp 大分 map (pref-47-large, 692x519), as fitted.
# px/py were read off a rain-free frame, 2025-12-09 09:00 JST, kept as
# it). Coordinates are from OpenStreetMap unless noted.
# Fit: RMS 0.84 px, worst 1.44 px, rotation -0.05 deg, scale 3.38 px/km.
# The result is in precip_extract.PREFECTURES[47]; see HANDOFF.md "Calibration"
#   Its coordinate and its pixel disagree by 3 km (the pixel reads as
#   131.9224, 32.7611) and including it induces a spurious 1.27 deg tilt,
#   costing 2.5 px of RMS. Prefecture borders are drawn generalised; read
#   capes, island tips and lighthouses instead.
# Commented-out candidates, coordinates from OSM, pixels never read. Useful if
# this fit is ever redone with more points.
